paper_metadata.title: Outcome of resective surgery for intractable partial epilepsy guided by subdural electrode arrays

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study describes the source population and recruitment period well, but there is a significant gap between the number of patients who underwent surgery (n=94) and those included in the analysis (n=64). This 32% loss at the 'zero time' of the study without detailed comparison of the excluded group introduces moderate selection bias.
